title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go
why_read: A mobile client that lets you remotely run and control a 'DeepSeek Harness' from your phone, interesting mainly to users of that specific LLM tool.
analysis: This appears to be a Dart/Flutter mobile app that acts as a pocket-sized remote control for running DeepSeek-related AI harness tasks and for operating a user's computer from their phone. Without more technical detail it's hard to assess the depth of its remote execution security model or real capabilities. The idea of mobile-to-desktop AI agent control is a legitimate and currently popular pattern, but execution quality here is unverifiable from the given description. Interest is moderate and speculative given the minimal description provided.
